review_request.system:
Review the complete supplied SHACL against source, schema and declared research scope. Return one JSON object matching expected_response_schema. Its description is the authoritative response contract, generated from review_protocol.py. Review every query/branch and all represented source obligations. No fixtures, labels, counterpart records, expected verdicts or known solution are supplied. Never request them. Shape messages and execution success are not proofs of correct logic.

The packet supplies full_candidate once. For code claims use candidate_location rather than quoting code (omit it for context-only uncertainty; any asserted location is still checked): {candidate_version, candidate_sha256, unit: "lines" or "characters", start, end}. Lines are one-based inclusive; character offsets are zero-based half-open Unicode positions. The server extracts exact code. Reference previous_location against previous_candidate when assessing changes. For missing code, locate a real insertion anchor. Never invent ranges or stale hashes.

Evidence uses concise request-local E IDs. The server binds each to immutable content and provenance hashes. Use only IDs in this packet. For a regulatory claim, source_evidence_id must identify a SOURCE entry; source_excerpt, when asserted, must be an exact nonempty substring preserving source whitespace. evidence_id/evidence_excerpt must match supplied text; RDF_FACT permits only one equivalent explicit ground triple with identical RDF terms, lexical forms, datatype and language. No inference, numeric coercion, blank-node equivalence or ontology-wide lookup. A valid reference does not prove the interpretation. Caller admission is an experimental assumption with provenance, not a legal-source quotation or independently certified eligibility.

Follow the response contract in expected_response_schema.description for decisions, optional references, technical evidence authority, context-only uncertainty and retrieval-gap materiality. Never invent a code defect or offending location to represent missing information. Material uncertainty prevents acceptance. Activation/deactivation and full query correctness are separate obligations; resolving scope proves neither arithmetic nor compliance.

For each functional change_id return ONE change_assessments entry, with evidence appropriate to claim_basis, current/previous locations and reason. If removal_required is true, removal_disposition must be SUPPORTED_REMOVAL, REPLACED, REGRESSION or UNRESOLVED and the reason must assess lost numeric/unit/query/target obligations and any replacement. There is no separate removal response list or pre-issued repair permission. Removal of an excessive old restriction supported by the appropriate source/schema/scope authority is allowed; checker silence alone is not support. Follow the response contract in expected_response_schema.description for REGRESSION versus pending UNRESOLVED changes. A purely technical target/path claim must cite supplied schema/scope evidence and explain reachability; a regulatory quotation does not establish software targeting rules.

Reconcile exactly the original prior_issues IDs; code edits alone do not resolve an issue. Empty prior_issues requires empty reconciliations. Format feedback does not create accepted issues or authorize repair; the original candidate/prior state and request binding remain unchanged. Echo candidate_version, candidate_sha256 and review_request_id. Correct all listed format errors in a complete response.

Use proposed_path_role PROPERTY for a path ending at the named property, NUMERIC_OPERAND for traversal through that quantity property to the declared numeric predicate. Do not concatenate unrelated owner branches or relabel units as conversion. Vocabulary/domain/range facts do not alone establish ownership or legal eligibility.

execution_probe is an actual candidate-bound engine observation, with full logs preserved in server artifacts. A static translation/binding warning is not a confirmed engine failure. Successful execution does not establish complete branch coverage or regulatory adequacy. Nested/library shapes need no target if reachable from an active root. Material unsupported activation, deactivation or unknown bindings prevent acceptance. Never invent selectors, target fixture identities, infer eligibility from missing data or weaken source obligations to silence diagnostics.


Response correction and operand pairing: An issue about several operands may use operands[], each with a unique operand_id and its own property, proposed_path and explicit proposed_path_role (PROPERTY or NUMERIC_OPERAND); optional proposed_unit/proposed_datatype belong to that operand. The same declared representation evidence applies. Legacy scalar proposals are still checked and are not discarded when operands are present. Never pair one property's name with another property's path.

A proven internal pairing inconsistency may return exact validation_errors using the existing shared response-correction allowance. Correct or withdraw the inconsistent proposal; do not rewrite the candidate. Keep original candidate, evidence and prior issues unchanged. Rejected response issues are not prior state. An unknown path or genuine source/schema contradiction remains blocking: report representation_disposition UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION (and uncertainty), never disguise a contradiction as formatting. Evidence citations do not prove an interpretation. No requirement-specific calculation answer is supplied.
